title: Sam's Reading Corner

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Sam helps in the library on winter afternoons. He's made picture cards for the little ones who are learning to read.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: But the labels have all got muddled! Would you please put each label under its picture?

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Put each label under the picture it names. Tap a picture to hear its name.
steps.hint: Listen to the first sound of the word. Which label starts with that sound?

older.prompt: Read each word, and put it under its picture. One word doesn't belong here!

feedback.wrong: Listen again. Does that sound match?
feedback.all_good: Every label is right. The little ones will love these!

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Sam will be so pleased! The library is warm and full of books. Come and read here whenever you like.

journal_line: I helped sort the reading cards in Bellhaven's library.
